log.msg: Steps 1-2 committed on worktree/whisper-log: WhisperLog (audio/Whisper) is one numbered event log (seq, run, t, src, kind, msg plus every extra field) appended to the existing ai/whisper/<date>.jsonl day file via FsFile - one store, already tailed by JSONL.live(). WhisperLogRows holds the read rules (diff, amend, duplicate). Dictate now reports req, segment, stale drops and the whole verbose_json reply (+70 ms per 8 s clip, so only a logged mic uses it). Page at /framework/audio/Whisper/log/. Whisper :8178 is up.

findings.text: The new page is unproven: every shot of /framework/audio/Whisper/log/ shows "Page Load Error — 404" (page 1) because the shots were taken on monorepo.localhost, the main tree, where `audio/Whisper/log/page.js` does not exist yet (it lives only on `worktree/whisper-log`, 0e3d2301e). Re-shoot from the worktree (or a private server on the branch) before merge; every layout answer below is "not measured" until then.

The parent Whisper page shots also predate the change: no "log" child appears in its nav or tabs at any width (shots/…-audio-Whisper/sheet.png), so "reachable by a visible link" (requirement 3) cannot be confirmed from evidence. The diff does add `children: "log"` and a readme link, so it should pass once re-shot.

`.wl` sizes itself by the viewport, `inline-size: max(20rem, calc(100vw - 24rem))`, ignoring the page's own column; at 3440 that is ~3056 px, and at 400 it is 320 px inside a ~344 px column with a 62em min-width row, so the table relies on horizontal scroll inside `.wl-rows`. Check both ends once the page renders (layout: sizing).

`ux/Dictate/WhisperLog.css` is left behind: the old class loaded it, the new re-export does not, so it is now an orphan stylesheet. Fine to keep (never destructive), but the Dictate readme/doc should say it is unused.

Every logged Whisper reply now stores the full `verbose_json` body in `server`, and identical interim guesses are no longer skipped (the old `record` skipped them), so the day file grows much faster on a logged mic. Intended for debugging; worth one line in `doc/whisper-log.md`.
Trailing whitespace after `form.append("response_format", this.response_format);` in `ux/Dictate/Dictate.js`.

The sticky header row doesn't cover the rows that scroll under it: "#" sits on top of "27" and "time" on top of "00:08:55.695", and a row's "+3 ms" shows through (layout 2, ui) — shots/…-Whisper-log/1920.png and 400.png, first row of the table. The header row needs a solid background and a height that fully covers what is behind it.

At 400 px the text column, the point of the page, is off-screen: only `#`, time, src and kind fit, and origin and text need a sideways scroll inside `.wl-rows` (`min-inline-size: 62em`). The hidden text also makes rows mostly blank and 70–90 px tall (sizing, wrapping) — shots/…-Whisper-log/400.png, rows 31–37. At narrow widths, stack each row (time · src · kind on one line, then the text).

The "commit-dropped" chip still wraps onto two lines at every width, even though the latest commit says chips don't wrap (wrapping) — 400.png row 31, 1920.png row 31, 3440.png row 31. The 9em kind column is too narrow for it.

`layout.json` and `sheet.png` for both pages are stale. They are from 19:13 and record the 404 (`widest_text_sample "404 — nothing matches…"`), while the pngs were re-shot at 19:15 and show the real page. So every layout number below is `not measured`, and I judged from the pngs alone.

At 3440 the table stops at 90rem and fills only about half the content area. The text column wraps to two lines while the right half of the screen is empty (sizing) — 3440.png. Also, `.wl` is sized by `100vw`, not by its column.
The origin column (11em) wraps "req 7 · seg 0 · 179 ms · conf 0.97 · nospeech 1e-12" onto 3 lines at 1920 — 1920.png row 29.
The times are UTC: run buttons read "10-17 00:08:50" and the clock column reads "00:08:55", but it is local evening on 10-16. Show local time, or label the times as UTC (words).
The page h1 "Whisper log" is followed at once by an h4 "WHISPER LOG: EVERY EVENT, IN ORDER", which repeats the title (content). Use the h4 slot for the stats line, or drop it.
The parent `audio` tab bar wraps "INBOX" onto a second row at 1200 (`tab_rows 2`). This was already there before this change, and the diff doesn't touch the bar.

The committed branch is broken: `WhisperLog.js` at `18c8329a4` (and in this diff) calls `h4.c("wl-title", …)` in `draw()` but imports only `View, div, span, button`, so `draw()` throws a ReferenceError and the table never renders. The shots look right only because `C:/Code/lew42/wt-whisper-log` has the h4 line deleted but **not committed** (`git status`: ` M WhisperLog.js`). Commit that one-line deletion before merge (code: traps that never throw).

At 1200 the text column, the point of the page, is cut off: rows keep `min-inline-size: 66em` (about 900 px) inside a `.wl` of `100vw - 24rem` (816 px), so "ask not w…" is clipped and needs a sideways scroll (sizing, wrapping) — shots/…-Whisper-log/1200.png, every row's right edge. Let the stacked layout start wider (the 48rem query) or shrink the fixed columns so 1200 fits.
No `layout.json` this round (the shots line has `"bands": []`), so every measured question is `not measured`, judged from the pngs. Widths given: 400, 1200, 1920, 3440 for both pages.
The `+N ms` gap under each clock is at `opacity: .5` on grey, which reads faint at every width (colour) — 1920.png, column 2.
The parent Whisper page links the log only through the sidebar; its own text never mentions it (navigation: findable) — shots/…-audio-Whisper/1200.png. A one-line link in its paragraph would help.
The `audio` tab bar still wraps INBOX to a second row at 1200; this was there before and the diff doesn't touch it — shots/…-audio-Whisper/1200.png, top band.
